notes.title: Easy passage of puzzles
notes.content: Fixed bugs found! In addition, the ability to instantly assemble a puzzle has been added. To do this, just press the "C" button on the keyboard!

notes.title: In-game updates!
notes.content:
1. Added the ability to view the original image of the photo!
2. Removed excess gamma in the images collected puzzles.
3. Made the background lighter
4. The soundtrack now repeats itself constantly!
5. Removed the ability to drag the final image with the assembled puzzle.
6. Reduced the difficulty of passing the game!
